spec2def(bthprops.cpl bthprops.cpl.spec)

# bthprops.cpl is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/bthprops-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(bthprops_shims OBJECT bthprops_main.c)
target_link_libraries(bthprops_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_canunload libbluetoothapis libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(bthprops_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(bthprops_shims)
add_cargo_module(bthprops bthprops-cargo bthprops.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS bthprops_shims psdk)
